add.title: List.insert should throw (not silently drop) when an id equals a property name on the list or its owner; add a `first` getter
add.why: Timeline worked example 2026-11-24: clips.add({id:'title'}) on a Timeline with a `title` field printed a warning and added nothing, so every later line under it vanished (List.js:43-51). Evidence: .scratch/timeline-research/example/report.md §5 issue 1.
